correction: The forky opt-in section told users to run a direct registry `bootc switch` to :forky and back to :latest. bootc's registry-transport composefs pull fails on snosi images, and a direct switch reads the system container policy, which root overrides can replace (ADR-0025). The commands now pull with Podman under /usr/lib/snosi/containers/bootc-policy.json and switch with --transport containers-storage, as bootc-update-stage does. The same review also corrected the /etc statement (per deployment, not shared on rollback) and the kernel warning (Snowfield carries linux-surface).
